extra.message: User-controlled input 'name' is directly formatted into a string template which is then compiled and rendered using Jinja2 (Template(content).render()). This allows for Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI), which can lead to Remote Code Execution (RCE).

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: A hardcoded secret token 'SUPER_SECRET_TOKEN' is defined directly in config.py instead of being retrieved from environment variables. This exposes sensitive credentials to version control and potential unauthorized access.
